incoming.explanation: The 1602-03 archdeaconry will of the East Dereham widow is the probate half of the pre-Francis household evidence.
The 1627/1636 Ellingfield abuttals independently document the widow's former copyhold at manor-court level.
By 1623-1635 the Gurney presence was a remembered parcel only - no active tenancy survived into John's boyhood.
The why-East-Dereham reading rests on the pre-Francis household finding.

statement: A Gurney copyhold household existed at East Dereham before Francis Gurney's residence years: the widow Margery Gurney, whose will was proved in the archdeaconry court in 1602-03 and whose former Ellingfield tenancy the manor courts still recited in 1627 and 1636. An established Gurney presence in John's birth parish therefore predates his c. 1609/10 baptism by a generation, though by his boyhood it survived only as a parcel memory.
